source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm the SUT configuration against the recipe, clear logs, check adapters for installation in each slot, then collect results/photos and inspect unexpected dmesg, syslog and SEL evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: Adapters should be installed and removed easily
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: A person must manipulate and inspect cable adapters; the agent cannot prove plug/unplug fit or physical condition over SSH.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify at every specified slot that the correct mechanical cable adapter can be installed, fully seated, retained and removed through the approved physical method without binding, abnormal resistance or physical damage.
original_test_intent.target: Each cable-adapter identity and its approved slot on one exact SUT, using the owner-approved adapter list and slot map; not an unspecified connector set or an arbitrary compatible-looking adapter.
original_test_intent.scope: One qualified manual removal/reinstallation fit check per listed adapter/slot pair, with per-slot observations and photos. Optional device enumeration or logs are post-action health evidence and do not replace the mechanical criterion or expand the case into an electrical performance test.
original_test_intent.operation: After the correct power/hot-plug state and ESD controls are established, an operator identifies each adapter and slot, records the as-found state, removes and reinstalls the adapter using the platform procedure, observes fit/retention/contact/guide condition without forcing it, then records the final state and any approved post-action detection evidence.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One removal/reinstallation check for each owner-listed adapter/slot pair; the source lists five attended and five machine minutes but no repeated campaign.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every approved adapter is in the correct slot and can be removed and reinstalled normally, seats and retains correctly, shows no connector/guide/contact damage, and leaves any required post-action device path healthy.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT identity, adapter part/serial identity, slot map, per-slot before/after photos, operator fit/removal observation, anomaly record, restored placement and, only where defined, post-action enumeration plus kernel/BMC/SEL deltas.
ambiguities: The source does not identify the adapters, slots, keyed orientation, hot-plug capability, removal tool/latch sequence or what measurable condition constitutes 'easily'.
It does not specify whether device detection is required after each plug cycle or merely supplemental evidence.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly makes the test per-slot, requires adapter identity and a slot map, gates removal by power/hot-plug and ESD procedure, prohibits force, preserves logs, and limits the agent to approved post-action evidence after the operator completes the physical check.

applicable_history.decision: The prior one-by-one review retained physical/manual execution and operator-supplied evidence for the install/remove-easily criterion.
Historical checkpoint metadata once used the wrong V002 code; the source-confirmed identity is row 22 / Wistron-HW-00021-V003. The invalid run is not review evidence.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The V2 classification and technical boundary are correct. The acceptance fact is manual per-slot installation/removal fit, while software detection is conditional supporting evidence rather than a substitute or an implicit expansion to cable electrical performance.

available_now: The source identifies per-slot adapter installation and easy removal/reinstallation as the physical acceptance activity.
An agent can prepare the slot evidence manifest and preserve read-only inventory/log baselines without manipulating hardware.
missing_inputs: Exact SUT, approved adapter part/serial list, slot map, orientation/keying and retention indicators
Component-specific removal/installation procedure, required tool/latch sequence, allowable power/hot-plug state and ESD controls
Owner definition of acceptable fit/ease and rules for binding, abnormal resistance, bent contacts, damaged guides or wrong-slot discovery
Per-slot photo requirements, evidence owner, whether post-action detection is required, and recovery for a missing or unhealthy device
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The mechanical/cable hardware owner supplies adapter identities, slot map, fit criteria and procedure; the lab owner supplies the qualified operator, power/ESD controls and approval; the device owner defines any post-action detection and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Inventory the SUT and currently enumerated devices only to plan identity correlation; do not infer physical fit from enumeration
Preserve existing kernel, device, BMC and SEL evidence without clearing it, and prepare a per-slot checklist/photo manifest
prohibited_until_closed: Do not remove, insert, swap, force or reorient an adapter before its identity, slot, power/hot-plug rule, ESD procedure and operator approval are verified
Do not clear logs, use an unapproved slot or adapter, repeat a binding action, or treat a visible device as proof that the adapter installs/removes correctly
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The target matrix and procedure are signed off; every adapter/slot pair has traceable before/action/after evidence; any required device path is restored; logs are preserved; and the hardware owner adjudicates subjective fit or damage.

revision_candidate.test_name: Per-Slot Mechanical Cable Adapter Fit Check
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify that every approved cable adapter can be removed from and reinstalled into its designated SUT slot normally, with correct seating/retention and no binding or damage.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server and approved adapter population in a controlled lab with qualified physical access, platform-defined power/hot-plug state and ESD controls.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every adapter/slot pair in the owner-approved slot map. Do not substitute another slot, adapter revision or generic connector, and do not expand the case into unspecified cable electrical performance.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SUT identity; adapter part/serial list; slot map and orientation; removal/installation and retention procedure; acceptable-fit criteria; power/hot-plug and ESD rules; operator approval; photos/evidence plan; optional post-action detection; recovery owner.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: No remote command performs the acceptance action. For each listed slot, the operator verifies identity and as-found state, follows the approved latch/tool sequence to remove and reinstall the adapter once, stops on abnormal resistance or damage, verifies seating/retention, photographs the result and reports completion before the agent collects any approved post-action device/log evidence.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact adapter-to-slot mapping confirmed; correct safe power/hot-plug state and ESD controls active; tools/latches and fit criteria known; evidence path ready; qualified operator and anomaly/recovery owner present.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Per-slot checklist with adapter and slot identities; before/after photos; operator record of removal/insertion fit, retention and physical condition; restored population; and defined post-action enumeration plus kernel/BMC/SEL deltas where required.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact platform's cable-adapter BOM, slot map, assembly/service procedure and owner-approved mechanical fit/retention criteria.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never hot-remove unless explicitly supported, force a binding adapter, touch contacts unnecessarily, swap slots, continue after damage, clear logs, or claim mechanical acceptance from software enumeration.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: A qualified operator performs every physical action. The hardware owner approves the target matrix, any hot-plug condition and every repair, reseat outside the planned cycle or final subjective fit disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Identification at the chassis, removal/reinstallation, tactile fit assessment and photography are manual. The agent may prepare the manifest and collect defined post-action evidence only after operator confirmation.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On binding, bent contact, damaged guide, wrong-slot discovery or device loss, stop and preserve the as-found state/evidence; do not retry or force. Follow only the owner-approved inspection/repair and restore/health procedure.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unidentified adapter or slot, missing procedure/fit criterion, unapproved power or hot-plug state, absent ESD/operator approval, abnormal resistance, physical damage, incorrect keying, device loss, new platform error, incomplete evidence or unavailable recovery owner.

identified_defects: The original source does not define the per-slot adapter matrix or acceptable fit/ease criteria.
The original instruction to clear logs would erase potentially relevant slot/device fault history.
DeepSeek's device-detection phrase is supporting evidence, not an explicit replacement for the mechanical criterion.
reason_for_change: No material V2 correction is needed. V3 keeps the per-slot manual conclusion while making the adapter/slot matrix, subjective-fit ownership and conditional role of post-action detection explicit.

new_technical_evidence.title: Functionality one-by-one review
new_technical_evidence.supports: The historic review independently retained physical/manual execution for the per-slot install/remove-easily criterion.

removed_ambiguities: Defines each adapter/slot pair as a separate observation rather than one generic cable check.
Separates mechanical fit acceptance from optional software detection and log evidence.
remaining_blockers: Physical execution waits for the exact adapter/slot matrix, fit procedure/criteria, safe power/ESD state and qualified operator.
objective_improvement_over_v2: No material technical conclusion changes because V2 already addresses per-slot scope, safety and evidence correctly. V3 adds explicit readiness ownership and prevents optional device detection from being mistaken for the physical acceptance test.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The high-risk manual contract is queued for the later risk-weighted isolated validation set.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source requires adapters to be checked for installation in each slot and to install/remove easily.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 already makes the test per-slot and manual, protects power/ESD/log evidence and permits only conditional post-action software checks.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: The operator must use the approved adapter/slot map and stop on binding or damage; the agent cannot manipulate the adapter or claim fit from enumeration.
